name: Canton Venues open API
about: Live, read-only market data for Canton Network trading venues. No key, cross-origin enabled, refreshed every five minutes; every snapshot file carries t, the unix time of its snapshot (alerts and desk are running records; history's t is the list of its sample times).

endpoints.name: summary
endpoints.about: Canton Coin price, ecosystem figures, how many tokens and venues are priced, and the pools marked not trading

endpoints.name: tokens
endpoints.about: every token: price, liquidity, 24h volume, 24h change (none for a token that traded under $1K in 24h), 7d change, the venues it trades on, 7-day hourly sparkline

endpoints.name: execution
endpoints.about: best execution: every venue quoted at $100, $1K, $10K and $50K, both directions, each by its best route on its own markets (one swap or two), net of each venue's network fee (network_fee documents the fee per venue and whether it was measured or assumed); market_mid is the market price sizes are converted at, not_trading names pools left out

endpoints.name: premium
endpoints.about: each asset's Canton price against its outside reference (CoinGecko; gold and silver spot from Ekiden's index while the spot market trades) or its $1 peg, overall and per venue; a token that traded under $1K in 24h shows no figure

endpoints.name: scan
endpoints.about: every cross-venue round trip at its best size, after costs

endpoints.name: spreads
endpoints.about: daily spread study: how long cross-venue spreads live

endpoints.name: alerts
endpoints.about: active alerts and the feed of every alert fired (spreads, pegs, premiums)

endpoints.name: venues
endpoints.about: every Canton venue: type, 24h volume, what is read

endpoints.name: venue_history
endpoints.about: per venue: daily volume and hourly readings

endpoints.name: lp
endpoints.about: pools: liquidity, 24h volume, fee, fee APR

endpoints.name: pools
endpoints.about: raw reserves of every CC pool, the pools of two other tokens a route can take, and order-book levels per venue, the inputs every quote is computed from; not_trading lists pools whose reserves stood still while their price left the market (in no price or comparison)

endpoints.name: perps
endpoints.about: perp markets on Rocky and Ekiden: price, basis, funding, spread

endpoints.name: history
endpoints.about: eight days of prices and premiums in five-minute steps (large, ~1.2 MB)

endpoints.name: desk
endpoints.about: the paper desk's full record: router and arbitrage simulated on live quotes

endpoints.name: quotecheck
endpoints.about: the hourly check of our pool math against the venues' own quote engines (Tradecraft, Cantex): every trade compared, the largest gap, and Cantex's network fee per pair

endpoints.name: arkiv
endpoints.about: where the hourly record on Arkiv (Tiramisu testnet) lives: each hour the quote check and the best-execution verdicts are written as readonly entities whose contents cannot be changed afterwards; the creator address, the query to read them, and the latest entity of each kind

endpoints.name: weekly
endpoints.about: the rolling last-7-days volume card by venue and day
